results.summary_before: Clementine is a 4-lane int8 SIMT GPU that is programmed and controlled over an SPI interface using the standard SPI Pmod pinout. Status outputs report when the sequencer has halted, whether any lane is active, instruction commit, and replay state, which together expose hardware divergence handling. The documentation is limited to the title, pin names, and a short description, so the instruction set, memory model, and test procedure are not described. It is notable for implementing SIMT execution with hardware divergence on a 2x2 tile area.
results.summary: This is a character-level transformer language model with ternary weights baked into on-tile ROM. It streams int16 residuals in and int8 residuals out over a byte-wide handshake, one token per transaction. The chip performs transformer layers including RMSNorm, a minGRU mixer, and an MLP, while the host handles character tables and final sampling. The design is documented with a reference RP2350B host, test procedure, and debug status pins.
